name: toit-recon
description: Toit payment reconciliation — Next.js frontend + Node API + Postgres + S3

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @toit/api && npm run build --workspace @toit/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @toit/recon-core && npm run test --workspace @toit/mpr-core
